policy: ESSENTIAL runs on PRs and merge groups plus changed-area cases. GATED-FULL is implicit for every unlisted discovery; manifests contain tier exceptions and scheduling/deletion metadata. NIGHTLY includes never-gated browser cases. Runtime reconciliation gates new cases without warnings and drops stale explicit entries with warnings; implicit browser routing follows native discovery. Known-flaky cases and deletion candidates cannot be ESSENTIAL; AEON-678 rule B removes reviewed low-value categories; protected candidates stay available.
source: AEON-678 zb-go essential allowlist (332 including two dispatch helpers)

timingWeights.basis: Measured full-gate owner costs. Go: terminal package elapsed; unit: Vitest startTime-to-endTime or top-level Node durations. Residual tier executionMinutes are apportioned equally across that shard's owner launches, including native enumeration/launch overhead. Separate workflow checks and runner setup are excluded. Missing owners retain prior explicit estimates; partial selections scale by active selected case count.
